thesis: The episode maps the evolution of media from centralized institutions to internet-native platforms, highlighting how Craigslist disrupted local advertising revenue and how the music industry's experience with Napster created widespread anxiety among other media businesses. The discussion also examines how unionization in legacy media, such as the Wall Street Journal's history of hand-built servers, can create structural incompatibilities with necessary technological change.
